zh: 子数组和可以写成两个前缀和之差：右端为 r、左端前缀下标为 l 时和为 p[r]-p[l]，长度至少 K 等价于 l ≤ r-K。
固定右端 r，要让和最大，就要从 p[0..r-K] 里减去最小的那个前缀和；随着 r 右移，可选前缀只会多一个，最小值可以顺手维护。
先算前缀和 p[0..N]。r 从 K 扫到 N：先用 p[r-K] 更新最小前缀，再用 p[r] 减最小前缀更新答案。答案初值设成负无穷，因为全是负数时结果也可能是负的，空数组不合法。
en: A subarray sum is a difference of prefix sums: with right end r and left prefix index l it is p[r]-p[l], and a length of at least K means l <= r-K.
For a fixed right end r, the best sum subtracts the smallest prefix among p[0..r-K]. As r moves right, exactly one more prefix becomes available, so the minimum can be maintained on the fly.

Compute prefix sums p[0..N]. Scan r from K to N: first update the running minimum with p[r-K], then update the answer with p[r] minus that minimum. Start the answer at negative infinity, since with all-negative input the result is negative and the empty subarray is not allowed.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Scan the right end r, and subtract from the prefix sum the minimum prefix sum among indices <= r-K.

## Correctness

All valid left ends for a fixed right end correspond exactly to prefix indices 0..r-K; subtracting the minimum prefix gives the best value for that right end, and enumerating right ends gives the global optimum.

## Complexity

Time O(N), space O(N).
